spec_provided_observability: Per-port RX Error Counters (ESC 0x0300-0x030F): Frame Error, Physical RX Error, Forwarded RX Error.
ESC DL Status (0x0110): per-port Link status, Loop state (open / closed), Signal Detect, PDI operational.
AL Status (0x0130) + AL Status Code (0x0134) — IEC 61158-defined ESM error numbers.
Working Counter (WKC) per datagram — direct in-band check that every addressed SubDevice executed.
Distributed Clock difference counter (0x092C) — observable drift / sync quality.
Mailbox handshake state bits in SM0/SM1 Status (0x0805 / 0x080D).
error_detection_mechanisms: Ethernet FCS (CRC-32) on every frame; hardware-counted in Frame Error Counter; corrupted frames are still forwarded but marked.
Working Counter check on every datagram (MainDevice computes expected; mismatch indicates missing or misconfigured SubDevice).
ESM-state cross-check: BRD 0x0130 sweep returns OR-aggregated state of all SubDevices; MainDevice can detect any state divergence in one frame.
Distributed Clock System Time Difference monitor: continuous reading of 0x092C reveals if a SubDevice loses sync.
PD Watchdog (Process-Data Watchdog): auto-transitions Op → SafeOp if no cyclic frame arrives within the configured window (typically 100 ms).
PDI Watchdog: SubDevice CPU must periodically write a 'kick' value; if it stops, ESC drives outputs to Safe state.
Mailbox handshake timeout: MainDevice retries on Counter mismatch / timeout.
SII checksum: bit 8 of EEPROM Control/Status (0x0502) reports a checksum mismatch on SII load.
Cable-length / propagation-delay sanity: DC measurement during start-up detects implausible cable distances.

test_modes.name: Independent Diagnostic Interface (MainDevice-side)
test_modes.description: A dedicated read-only command set (FPRD on selected ESC registers) lets any external diagnostic tool walk the network and snapshot CRC counters, link state, port counters, ESM state — without disturbing the cyclic exchange. ETG.1500 conformance test exercises this interface.

test_modes.name: EtherCAT Conformance Test Tool (CTT)
test_modes.description: ETG-provided official tool that drives a SubDevice through every mandatory + optional protocol path, validates every register, ESM transition, mailbox protocol, FMMU/SM behavior, and DC compatibility. Pass is a precondition for ETG certification.

test_modes.name: Cable Loopback / Hardware Loopback
test_modes.description: Each ESC port has hardware-implemented auto-loopback when the link partner is absent. Manual loopback testing is performed by physically looping the TX/RX of one port.

test_modes.name: PHY Loopback (ESC MII master loopback)
test_modes.description: ESC can be commanded via MII Management (0x0510-0x0516) to put a PHY into internal loopback for at-speed BIST of the on-the-fly engine.

test_modes.name: Process-Data Watchdog test mode
test_modes.description: Process-Data Watchdog can be intentionally disabled via SM Control bit 6 to exercise the silent-fail path during compliance testing.

test_modes.name: EEPROM emulation mode
test_modes.description: Bit 8 of 0x0500 EEPROM Configuration enables PDI-emulated SII — the µC supplies the SII content instead of an external EEPROM. Used in low-cost designs and in test/development.

interrupt_or_event_sources.name: ECAT Interrupt
interrupt_or_event_sources.description: ESC interrupt to MainDevice (via AL Status interrupt OR'ed into IRQ field of next datagram passing through).

interrupt_or_event_sources.name: PDI Interrupt
interrupt_or_event_sources.description: ESC interrupt output pin (INT_n / IRQ) to local µC; mask in 0x0200-0x020F.

interrupt_or_event_sources.name: SYNC0 / SYNC1
interrupt_or_event_sources.description: Distributed Clock output pulses to local µC for cycle synchronization.

interrupt_or_event_sources.name: LATCH0 / LATCH1 events
interrupt_or_event_sources.description: External rising/falling edge → System Time capture.

interrupt_or_event_sources.name: SM Event
interrupt_or_event_sources.description: SyncManager buffer empty / full / written interrupt.

interrupt_or_event_sources.name: Mailbox Event
interrupt_or_event_sources.description: SM0 Mailbox-Out written / SM1 Mailbox-In read interrupt.

loopback_modes_summary: Three loopback paths: (1) Per-port hardware auto-loopback when link partner absent — the foundation of daisy-chain auto-return. (2) Manual port loopback via DL Control 0x0100-0x010F (force loop state per port). (3) PHY internal loopback via MII management.
diagnostic_tools_external: ETG Conformance Test Tool (CTT) — official compliance suite
Beckhoff TwinCAT System Manager — graphical network configurator + on-line diagnostic
Wireshark with EtherCAT dissector — frame-level capture and decode (EtherType 0x88A4)
EtherCAT Explorer / acontis EC-Inspector / KPA EtherCAT Studio — third-party diagnostic toolchains
ETG.1500 Conformance Mark — visible badge on certified products
notes: Diagnostic data is collected non-intrusively during cyclic exchange: a periodic BRD to 0x0130 (AL Status) + a periodic BRD to 0x0300 (Frame Error Counter) costs only one datagram each per cycle and snapshots the whole network. The MainDevice independent diagnostic interface is a key differentiator vs. classical fieldbuses — any tool can read the live status without becoming the MainDevice.
